name: v2.5.26-dev.2-alpha7
body:
## What's new in v2.5.26-dev.2-alpha7

- tests: stub the Bluetooth radio probe in the speaker tests
- kiosk: album/artist queue buttons confirm only what Lyrion accepted (#120)
- player: resume only the internal player on boot, keep speakers paused (#124)
- kiosk: keep the breadcrumb trail from running over "Back" (#113)
- kiosk: let a real keyboard type into the on-screen keyboard (#114)
- player: pause all local players on shutdown instead of resuming on boot (#124)
- bluetooth: don't offer the switch when there is no adapter
- files: check free space when copying to the second disk too
- kiosk: remind to remove the USB stick in the power dialog
- kiosk: confirm the album/artist queue buttons with a toast
- kiosk: show the basename for a folder literally named "0"
- signal path: a remote player's path is unknown, not processed
- files: name the roots System disk / Second disk in the folder picker
